label: H2 (refined after the bank screen): the closing object/amount (or final period) of a hypothetical projection claim that a deliberate action or intervention WOULD/COULD change a measurable quantity -- money accumulated or saved, a bill or cost reduced, efficiency/yield/return raised, risk lowered -- typically with a possessor or a number on the target ('would have close to N3,000', 'would reduce your electricity bill', 'could increase their efficiency').
